title: Forward-Value Discretization: Faster Stochastic Diffusion Sampling Without High-Order Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stochastic diffusion samplers often require substantially more neural function evaluations (NFEs) than deterministic samplers to achieve comparable sample quality. Although higher-order discretization accelerates deterministic sampling, its benefits for stochastic sampling remains unclear. We establish matching upper and worst-case lower bounds showing that stochastic samplers with higher-order approximations remain first-order convergent, even with exact score functions. Thus, increasing the approximation order does not generally improve the convergence order. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce forward-value discretization, a training-free framework that evaluates the data/noise prediction model at a lookahead estimate constructed from previous predictions. translated_title: 前向值离散化：无需高阶近似的更快随机扩散采样
translated_abstract: 随机扩散采样器通常需要比确定性采样器多得多的神经函数评估次数（NFE）才能达到相当的样本质量。尽管高阶离散化能够加速确定性采样，但其对随机采样的益处尚不明确。我们建立了匹配的上界与最坏情况下的下界，表明即使使用精确的分数函数，采用高阶近似的随机采样器仍然只具有一阶收敛性。因此，提高近似阶数通常并不能改善收敛阶数。受此局限性的启发，我们提出了前向值离散化，这是一种免训练的框架，它在由先前预测构建的前瞻估计处评估数据/噪声预测模型。对于确定性采样，由此得到的 Forward DPMSolver（F-DPMSolver）通过其基于 DDIM 的变体，在低 NFE 预算下提升了样本质量，尽管仍保持一阶……
tldr: 该论文证明了高阶近似无法提升随机扩散采样的收敛阶数，并提出免训练的前向值离散化方法（F-DPMSolver），通过利用先前预测构建的前瞻估计，在低神经函数评估次数下实现更快的采样并提升样本质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that higher-order approximations do not improve the convergence order of stochastic diffusion sampling, and proposes a training-free forward-value discretization framework (F-DPMSolver) that uses lookahead estimates built from previous predictions to achieve faster sampling and better sample quality at low NFE budgets.
